Name: Lovely Wall Panels (CP)
Author: lululovely
Description:
Choose a simple or fancy style of raised molding, a solid wall with chair rail, or a vertical wooden paneling with 18 available colors. [i](In a future update, I'd love to be able to give you the option of using more than one, but I could not figure out the coding.)[/i]

Buy the [b]Lovely Wall Panels Catalogue [/b]from Robin's shop for 10,000g. Each panel piece or pillar can be placed on the wall like a painting. Windows are perfectly sized to fit over matching wallpaper swatches, and you can make custom sizes with left, middle, and right pieces.

The matching wallpapers in 18 colors will appear in the flooring and wallpaper catalogue from Pierre. You can choose to turn these on or off in the mod's config file.

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

[b]*** CONFIGURATION OPTIONS ***[/b]

Choose your wall panel colors: gray, pink, birch, white, yellow, red, mint, green, walnut, cream, lilac, purple, sky, blue, oak, black, navy, or orange.
Include the wallpapers (all 18 colors, 5 styles each) by choosing "true" in the config file.

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

- The colors match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]Lovely Kitchen[/url] and  [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras[/url][/b] perfectly!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =
